text:
anya: Heads-up — onboarding Zephyr-v1 (q5 -> q8) on staging uncovered a weird translation delta for CJK + numeric ranges. example attached in evals.
sam: can you paste the minimal repro? is it tokenization or model output? :thinking_face:
anya: short repro:
li: " + "```
src: 我们将在2024-01-15至2024-01-20之间进行迁移。
ref: We will migrate between 2024-01-15 and 2024-01-20.
zephyr-q8: We will migrate from 2024 年 1 月 15 日 到 2024 年 1 月 20 日。
```
" + "looks like extra fullwidth spacing and a duplicated date phrase in en output. BLEU dropped ~6 points on date-heavy subset.
jorge: that's interesting — is tokenizer producing extra subtokens for the numeric range? can you dump tokens?
anya: token dump (Zephyr tokenizer): " + "`[CLS] 我 们 将 在 2024 - 01 - 15 至 2024 - 01 - 20 之 间 进 行 迁 移 。 [SEP]`
sam: those hyphens become separate tokens around numbers — could be our normalization pipeline adding ASCII hyphens vs fullwidth. any difference between float32 model and q8 run?
anya: float32 (hosted) output is correct. only q8 quantized variant shows the duplicated phrase and spacing artifacts.
li: that suggests a quantization-related detokenize/regression rather than training data. maybe postprocess mapping for numeric spans is sensitive to token boundary changes after quant.
jorge: run a quick shadow eval: compare tokenizer->detok roundtrip across float32 vs q8. I can trigger it on the date-numeric slice.
ci-bot: ci:trigger shadow-eval --suite dates_numeric_slice --models zephyr-fp32,zephyr-q8 --env staging
sam: also check kv-cache behavior for long numeric tokens. I remember a bug where long contiguous digits triggered a fallback path in runtime which altered spacing.
anya: good call — I saw a few examples where prefix caching reflowed the first date. attaching logs: `reflow_patch=True` in the q8 path for some requests.
li: can you run bisect to see whether quant step changed tokenizer artifacts? maybe quant-spec updated kernel selection.
anya: starting bisect now. if anyone wants to follow: I'll post intermediate checkpoints. current hypothesis: quant kernel selection + detok merging threshold caused split/merge change around hyphenated numeric tokens.
jorge: ping infra on the runtimes team — could be different kernel for int8 matmul on latest build. @infra-team
sam: short-term mitigation: add a post-detokenize pass that normalizes numeric ranges (regex: `(\d{4}\s*[-〜to至]\s*\d{4})` -> unify). Not ideal but buys us time.
li: agree. we'll also add the date-numeric subset to regression evals and block q8 rollout to prod.
anya: will add an eval guard and disable canary for q8 until bisect completes. thanks all.
sam: thanks — please @me when bisect finds the commit or kernel id.
ci-bot: ci:shadow-eval queued (job 98233). results ETA ~12m.
